lines.en: label karindate25:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了点 Karin 的名字，等着她接电话。

lines.en: Given the fact that I am no longer the coach of the soccer team and can no longer hide these impromptu afternoon meetings behind the guise of supervising her training, I decide to just...go for it when she answers.
lines.zh: 鉴于我已经不再是足球社的教练，没法再用「监督她训练」当幌子来掩盖这些临时起意的午后约会，我决定等她一接就……直奔主题。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Let’s hang out.
lines.zh: : 我们出去玩吧。

lines.en: : AHHHH!!!
lines.zh: : AHHHH!!!

lines.en: Okay. Maybe I “went for it” a little too directly as Karin’s initial reaction was to just hang up.
lines.zh: 好吧。也许我「直奔主题」得太直接了点，因为 Karin 的第一反应是直接挂电话。

lines.en: Thankfully, I think I know her well enough at this point to predict that in several seconds, she’s going to call me back and apologize.
lines.zh: 幸好，我觉得自己已经足够了解她，能预料到几秒钟之后她就会打回来道歉。

lines.en: Knew it.
lines.zh: 果然。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry! I don’t know what happened! I just...sometimes I press buttons! It’s a thing that happens!
lines.zh: : 对不起对不起！我不知道怎么回事！我只是……有时候会乱按！这种事是会发生的！

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re okay with hanging out, then?
lines.zh: : 那这是不是就表示你愿意跟我出去玩了？

lines.en: : It happened again!
lines.zh: : 又来了！

lines.en: : Should I proceed with inviting you to do something? Or would you rather we just skip that conversation altogether and decide on a place to meet?
lines.zh: : 那我要继续邀请你做点什么吗？还是说你更希望我们直接跳过这段对话，先把见面地点定下来？

lines.en: : I...I’d love to come meet up with you! I just...umm...I’m kind of already doing something, so-
lines.zh: : 我……我很想和你见面！只是……嗯……我现在正好有点事，所以——

lines.en: : {i}Karin, who’s that? And how come ya keep yellin’ at ‘em if ya actually wanna go meet up?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Karin，谁啊？你要是真想跟人家见面，干嘛还一直冲着人家喊啊？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s umm...uhh...
: You can tell her, it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你告诉她就行，没关系。

lines.en: : It’s...It’s Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是……是 Sensei。

lines.en: : {i}What the heck? Sensei’s callin’ you? I ain’t gonna have to compete against two of my best friends now, am I?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}搞什么鬼？Sensei 给你打电话？该不会现在连我最好的两个朋友都得跟我抢人了吧？{/i}

lines.en: : C...Compete?
lines.zh: : 抢……抢人？

lines.en: : It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: And one that involves more fingering than I should probably include in a conversation with Karin at this point in time.
lines.zh: 而且这故事里涉及的手指动作，估计也不太适合在现阶段跟 Karin 讲。

lines.en: : {i}Karin! Tell Sensei I love him! And that my unquenchable desire for him grows stronger every day!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Karin！告诉 Sensei 我爱他！还有我对他无法满足的渴望每天都在变强！{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...Ayane says something about...unquenchable desire?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ayane 说了什么……无法满足的渴望？

lines.en: : {i}Ask him if he can watch my parrot while I go to the spa tomorrow!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}问问他明天我去水疗的时候能不能帮我照看我的鹦鹉！{/i}

lines.en: : And Miss Imai has a parrot.
lines.zh: : 还有 Imai 小姐养了只鹦鹉。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : This has been a very informative phone call. Thank you, Karin.
lines.zh: : 这通电话真是让我长了不少见识。谢谢你，Karin。

lines.en: : I’m...sorry I can’t do anything right now! The girls from the club made plans to put something together for Makoto today because of her dad, so...
lines.zh: : 我……很抱歉现在什么都做不了！社团的女生们约好今天要为 Makoto 她爸爸的事准备点东西，所以……

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll be right over.
lines.zh: : 明白了。我马上过去。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. Are all of you at the pool right now?
lines.zh: : 嗯。你们现在都在泳池那边吧？

lines.en: : I mean, we are. Yeah. But I can’t imagine you want to spend your weekend on-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们是在。不过我实在想不到你会想把周末花在——

lines.en: : Sounds to me like you’re underestimating just how badly I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，你是低估了我有多想见你。

lines.en: : AHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!

lines.en: Karin hangs up again, but I saw it coming this time.
lines.zh: Karin 又挂了一次，不过这次我早就料到了。

lines.en: Without anything else to do today, I begin making my way over to the school to help with whatever the swim club has decided to “put together” for Makoto.
lines.zh: 今天没有别的事可做，我便动身去学校，打算帮游泳社做点她们决定为 Makoto「准备」的东西。

lines.en: And while the thought of this is something that should hold the head of my day underwater long enough to drown it in a sea of my worries, my desire to stay {i}above{/i} water for now wins out in the end.
lines.zh: 虽然光是想想这件事，就足以把我这一天的脑袋按进水里、淹死在烦恼的汪洋中，但我想暂时{i}浮在水面上{/i}的念头最终还是占了上风。

lines.en: Because even if there’s one girl suffering beyond the reach of all of us right now, there are plenty more that aren’t.
lines.zh: 因为就算此刻有一个女孩正承受着我们所有人都够不着的痛苦，也还有更多女孩并没有。

lines.en: Dragging the broken one back is a task that would prove impossible for just one person, but the efforts of a group will surely be much better in that regard.
lines.zh: 把那个已经碎掉的人拖回来，光靠一个人是不可能做到的，但一群人的努力在这方面无疑会好得多。

lines.en: And being a part of that, even if it’s only for a small amount of time, is sure to help me as well...
lines.zh: 而成为其中一份子，哪怕只有一小段时间，也一定能帮到我自己……

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip1
: Welcome to the party, Sensei! I’ve only cried one time!
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到派对，Sensei！我今天才哭过一次！

lines.en: : That sounds like a reasonable improvement from how you’ve been lately, so good for you.
lines.zh: : 比起你最近的状态，这算是相当大的进步了，值得表扬。

lines.en: : There’s plenty of pizza if you want any, Senpai. Ayane’s butler did a hell of a job carrying all of it in here in just one trip.
lines.zh: : 想吃披萨的话这儿有的是，Senpai。Ayane 家的管家可真厉害，一趟就把这么多全搬进来了。

lines.en: : He cooked it himself as well. If you showed up a few minutes earlier, you might’ve even finally got to meet him.
lines.zh: : 披萨也是他亲手做的。你要是早来几分钟，说不定终于能见到他了。

lines.en: : Also, do you not love me anymore?
lines.zh: : 还有，你是不是不爱我了？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip2
: Oh, nothing. I just figured you would have called me instead of Karin given that she doesn’t even know about the rooftop apocalypse team yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。我只是觉得你会打给我而不是 Karin，毕竟她还不知道天台末日小队的事呢。

lines.en: : The...what now?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么小队？

lines.en: : Hahahah...I’m sure he just...clicked on my name instead of my sister’s on accident...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……我猜他只是……不小心点成了我的名字，而不是我妹妹的……

lines.en: : Does it really matter who I called now that I’m spending time with all of you?
lines.zh: : 既然我现在是陪着你们所有人，那我打给谁真有那么重要吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, it does.
lines.zh: : 有。当然有。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip3
: But {i}I guess{/i} I can overlook that since I also understand and appreciate just how wonderful Karin is.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}我想{/i}我可以不计较，因为我也明白并且欣赏 Karin 有多好。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what this stuff about being wonderful is, but I’m glad you were able to come by and help.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂你们说的「好」是什么意思，不过我很高兴你能过来帮忙。

lines.en: : No need to thank me. I care about Makoto as well and I’m sure that whatever this is will do a lot more for her than I’ve been able to do on my own.
lines.zh: : 不用谢。我也在乎 Makoto，而且我相信你们做的这些，对她的作用肯定比我一个人做的要大得多。

lines.en: : It would be good to know exactly {i}what{/i} you’re putting together, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是想知道你们到底在准备些{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s just a little...care package thing. Cards...gifts...stuff like that. I don’t really know much about Makoto yet, though...so I haven’t been as helpful as I’d like.
lines.zh: : 就是一个小小的……慰问包裹之类的。卡片……礼物……这类的东西。不过我还不太了解 Makoto……所以没能帮上多少我本来想帮的忙。

lines.en: : She says, despite being the one to come up with this idea.
lines.zh: : 她这么说，尽管点子是她自己出的。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip4
: Well...when I sprained my ankle playing softball when I was little, the rest of the team did something like this for me and it...really made me feel a lot better.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我小时候打垒球扭伤脚踝的时候，队里其他人也为我做过类似的事，那……真的让我好受了很多。

lines.en: : Obviously what Makoto is going through is a million times worse than that, but...I still figured it might make her a little happy to get something from all of her friends.
lines.zh: : 当然，Makoto 现在经历的事比那要糟上一百万倍，不过……我还是觉得，能收到所有朋友送的东西，她应该会稍微开心一点。

lines.en: : I don’t know if “happiness” is something she’s personally able to feel right now, but I do think she’ll appreciate the gesture.
lines.zh: : 我不确定她现在是否还能感受到「开心」这种情绪，但我确实觉得她会领这份情。

lines.en: : So, what can I do to help?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能帮上什么忙？

lines.en: : You can get lost, that’s what.
lines.zh: : 你可以滚一边去，这就是你能帮的。

lines.en: : Wow. Fuck you too, Imani.
lines.zh: : 哇。去你的，Imani。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip5

: No, like seriously. We’ve already got a lot of the things we need, but if we’re gonna stick to Karin’s plan and put together the world’s greatest care package, we’re gonna need a bunch of other stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是，我说真的。需要的大部分东西我们已经有了，可要是真按 Karin 的计划做出全世界最棒的慰问包裹，我们还得再弄一堆别的东西。

lines.en: : Plus, the other two girls and I have to go around collecting signatures from all of the {i}other{/i} girls anyway, which is a big ask on its own.
lines.zh: : 而且我和另外两个女生还得挨个去找{i}其他{/i}所有女生收集签名，光是这件事就够呛了。

lines.en: : The other {i}two{/i} girls? But there are four of you.
lines.zh: : 另外{i}两个{/i}女生？可你们有四个人啊。

lines.en: : Yeah. But you and Karin are gonna go out on a date, obviously.
lines.zh: : 对啊。不过很明显，你和 Karin 要出去约会嘛。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip6
: D-D-D-D-DATE?!
lines.zh: : 约、约、约、约、约会？！

lines.en: : US?!
lines.zh: : 我们两个？！

lines.en: : Guh. Startin’ to make sense why Makoto’s always so stressed when it comes to Sensei seein’ other girls.
lines.zh: : 呃。我开始明白为什么 Makoto 一听说 Sensei 去见别的女生就那么紧张了。

lines.en: : So that’s how it’s going to be, Sensei? You take me up on the roof just to leave me for Karin? Has this been your plan all along?
lines.zh: : 所以就是这样了吗，Sensei？你把我带上天台，就是为了甩掉我去找 Karin？你一开始就打的是这个算盘？

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip7
: This was never a plan! I didn’t even know Sensei was coming! And I didn’t know I was leaving until thirty seconds ago!
lines.zh: : 这从来就不是什么计划！我根本不知道 Sensei 要来！而且我也是三十秒前才知道自己要走的！

lines.en: : That’s just what she wants us to think, Ayane. Karin might look sweet on the outside...but on the inside? She’s just as conniving as the rest of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 她就是想让我们这么想而已，Ayane。Karin 外表看着是很甜……可内里呢？她跟其他人一样会算计。

lines.en: : Are you proud of yourself, Imani? Sowing the seeds of destruction in your own club?
lines.zh: : 你倒是挺得意的嘛，Imani？在自己的社团里播下毁灭的种子？

lines.en: : Hey, my original gameplan before you showed up was to just take everybody to the mall {i}myself{/i} after collecting signatures. You being here just means things are getting easier for me too.
lines.zh: : 喂，你出现之前我原本的计划是，收集完签名就{i}自己{/i}带大家去商场。你在这儿对我来说也省事了。

lines.en: : Plus, this’ll give you and Karin some of that “alone time” I’m sure you called her for and she’s a lot closer to being legal than everybody else you’re always hanging around with.
lines.zh: : 而且这样你和 Karin 就能有我猜你打电话找她要的那种「独处时间」了，再说她比你平时混在一起的那群人要接近成年得多。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip8
: Can you all not look away like that?
lines.zh: : 你们别都这么刻意地把头转开行吗？

lines.en: : I...I...I guess if...the teacher says we have to go out...there’s...nothing I can do to prevent it!
lines.zh: : 我……我……我想既然……老师说我们得出去……那……那我也没办法阻止了！

lines.en: : You realize I’m a teacher too, right? And that Imani only exists to serve me?
lines.zh: : 你知道我也是老师吧？而且 Imani 存在的意义就是服侍我？

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip9
: Oof. Not cool, man. Not cool.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。过分了啊，老兄。过分了。

lines.en: : What? You-
lines.zh: : 什么？你——

lines.en: : Oh.
scene karinmalltrip10
: And to think that you were my {i}first.{/i} Does the heart of this fair maiden mean nothing to you?
lines.zh: : 想想看，你可是我的{i}第一个{/i}啊。这位少女的一片芳心，对你来说就一文不值吗？

lines.en: : Imani too?! When will it end?!
lines.zh: : 连 Imani 也是？！这什么时候才是个头啊？！

lines.en: : First what? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 第一个什么？我没听懂。

lines.en: : Okay, well...at the risk of Imani getting everyone here to turn against me, I suggest we head out. Especially since we apparently have to go all the way to the mall?...
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……冒着 Imani 让在场所有人都反过来对付我的风险，我建议我们出发吧。尤其是我们看来还得一路跑到商场去？……

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip11
: Hey, if you can find everything on Karin’s list elsewhere, feel free. I just figured the mall would be cool  because they have everything.
lines.zh: : 喂，你要是能在别的地方把 Karin 单子上的东西都买齐，随便你。我只是觉得商场挺好，因为那儿什么都有。

lines.en: : It definitely doesn’t have anything to do with my desire to remain forever young and wander the halls with a bunch of high school girls.
lines.zh: : 这绝对跟我想永远年轻、跟一群女高中生在商场里闲逛的念头没有任何关系。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure that much was just a complete coincidence.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢肯定那部分纯属巧合。

lines.en: : The list isn’t {i}that{/i} long, so...I’m sure we can finish quickly if you hate spending time with me.
lines.zh: : 单子没{i}那么{/i}长，所以……要是你讨厌跟我待在一起，我们肯定能很快搞定。

lines.en: : Why would I have called you at all if that were the case?
lines.zh: : 要是那样的话，我干嘛还要打电话给你？

lines.en: : Because Karin and Kirin are only one letter apart and...you have bad eyesight?
lines.zh: : 因为 Karin 和 Kirin 只差一个字母，而且……你眼神不好？

lines.en: : Oh, and speaking of phones, take my number down so we can meet back up once you guys are done.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到手机，把我的号码记一下，你们办完事我们再碰头。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip12
: What kinda smooth move is that, Miss Imai?! Just givin’ your number out like it’s a piece of friggin’ candy! Can’t ya see this guy is just gonna use ya as a booty call?!
lines.zh: : 这算哪门子老手操作啊，Imai 小姐？！把自己的号码随随便便给出去，跟发糖似的！你看不出来这家伙只会把你当成炮友吗？！

lines.en: : Hey, at least he’ll be saving money. All those carrier pigeons he’s been sending over to my place for analog booty calls are sure to get costly after a while.
lines.zh: : 嘿，至少他能省钱啊。他一直往我家送信鸽，就为了约那种老派的炮，日子久了那开销可不得了。

lines.en: : Sensei has never sent me a booty call pigeon...
lines.zh: : Sensei 从来没给我送过约炮的信鸽……

lines.en: : Pigeons ain’t even real! Birds are a conspiracy created by the government to watch us! Kirin showed me a video all about it!
lines.zh: : 鸽子根本就不存在！鸟类是政府编出来监视我们的阴谋！Kirin 给我看过一个专门讲这个的视频！

lines.en: : Okay, Karin. Come on. We’re leaving before this gets even more ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 好了，Karin。走吧。趁事情还没变得更离谱，我们先撤。

lines.en: scene black
Imani takes my phone and adds her contact info to it, preparing herself for a lifetime worth of booty calls that I highly doubt would yield any form of success at this point in time.
lines.zh: Imani 拿过我的手机，把自己的联系方式存了进去，做好了迎接一辈子炮友邀约的准备——而我非常怀疑，到这个阶段她那些邀约根本不可能有任何一次成功。

lines.en: Ayane and Miku go back to sulking as they pack things up and get ready to start soliciting signatures, while Karin and I awkwardly make our way out of the pool room and over to the nearest bus stop...
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Miku 一边继续生闷气，一边收拾东西、准备开始四处征集签名，而我和 Karin 则尴尬地走出泳池馆，朝最近的公交站走去……

lines.en: $ imaninumber = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Imani’s phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你获得了 Imani 的电话号码！{/i}

lines.en: scene sky
The bus arrives within minutes, sparing us from whatever sort of awkward conversation topics Karin was sure to come up with as we waited.
lines.zh: 几分钟后公交车就来了，免去了等车时 Karin 必然会憋出来的那些尴尬话题。

lines.en: That doesn’t prevent things from still {i}being{/i} awkward, though, as we take our seats on the bus and she has to endure the inner struggle of either sitting {i}next{/i} to me or in the seat across the aisle.
lines.zh: 不过这并没能阻止气氛继续尴尬下去——我们在车上坐下时，她还得经历一番内心挣扎：到底是坐我{i}旁边{/i}，还是坐过道对面。

lines.en: Thankfully, she bites the bullet and sits beside me so we don’t have to shout over a row of empty space just to be able to communicate with one another.
lines.zh: 幸好她咬咬牙坐到了我旁边，这样我们也不必隔着老远扯着嗓子说话。

lines.en: {i}Less{/i} thankfully, we wind up not communicating at all on the way to the mall, prompting me to believe that I would have preferred even the most awkward of conversation topics over that.
lines.zh: {i}不太妙{/i}的是，去商场的一路上我们一句话都没说，让我觉得哪怕是再尴尬的话题，也比这样要好。

lines.en: Once we’re back on land, though, she opens up again.
lines.zh: 不过等我们一回到地面上，她又重新打开了话匣子。

lines.en: I guess it’s only the thought of being trapped somewhere with me that eats away at her.
lines.zh: 我想，也只有被困在某处和我独处这件事，才会一点点地啃噬她。

lines.en: But despite my usage of the word “eat,” the form of consumption I’m referring to is not one of negativity.
lines.zh: 不过尽管我用了「啃噬」这个词，我所指的这番消耗并不是什么负面的东西。

lines.en: What is being eaten away is that lingering sense of purity of hers and how she is one of the only girls I know at this point who would deny the opportunity to sleep in my bed.
lines.zh: 被一点点啃噬掉的，是她身上那挥之不去的纯真，以及她是到这个阶段为止、我认识的少数几个会拒绝睡在我床上的女孩之一这件事。

lines.en: For in those moments we are trapped, she is forced to come to terms with things she struggles to understand about herself.
lines.zh: 因为在那些被困住的瞬间，她不得不去面对那些她始终无法理解的、关于她自己的事。

lines.en: And in those moments we are trapped, I must prevent myself from coming to terms with the things I understand about her.
lines.zh: 而在那些被困住的瞬间，我必须阻止自己去面对那些我已经理解的、关于她的事。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip13
We find ourselves on a bench I’m known to frequent, but never with her.
lines.zh: 我们坐到了一张我常去的长椅上，只是从来不曾和她一起。

lines.en: She sits where the other has, in slightly older yet slightly fresher skin as she looks up at me with a sense of unfamiliar unease deep inside of her emerald eyes.
lines.zh: 她坐在那个人曾坐过的位置上，肌肤略显成熟却又略显新鲜，抬眼看向我，那双翡翠般的眼眸深处藏着一丝陌生的不安。

lines.en: I think about plucking those valuable gems from out of her sockets and pawning them off for one more gift to a girl more tainted than she is.
lines.zh: 我琢磨着把那两颗珍贵的宝石从她的眼窝里挖出来，典当掉，再去给一个比她更污浊的女孩多买一份礼物。

lines.en: For it is those who feel the darkness creeping in that deserve the most-
lines.zh: 因为最该得到这一切的，是那些感觉到黑暗正悄悄爬进来的人——

lines.en: And it is those who have not yet been touched by it who must be left alone.
lines.zh: 而那些还没被它沾染的人，才是必须被放过的。

lines.en: : So...umm...
: I...guess I wasn’t busy after all?
lines.zh: : 我……想我其实也不算忙吧？

lines.en: : In all fairness, it’s not like this is a particularly {i}happy{/i} outing. We’re shopping for a girl who lost her dad.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，这趟出门本来也算不上什么{i}开心{/i}的事。我们是在给一个刚失去父亲的女孩买东西。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip14
: Yeah...
: I wish there was something more we could do.
lines.zh: : 真希望我们还能多做点什么。

lines.en: : I think what we’re doing now is plenty. Makoto seems like she wants to grieve in silence for the most part. So as long as she knows we’ll be here whenever she comes out of her cave, she’ll probably be fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在做的已经够多了。Makoto 看起来多半是想自己一个人静静地哀悼。所以只要她知道等她从自己的洞穴里走出来时我们一直都在，她大概就会没事的。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip15
: Or not.
lines.zh: : 也可能不会。

lines.en: : Death is complicated.
lines.zh: : 死亡是很复杂的事。

lines.en: : To some people, it’s like the world is falling apart. But to some others, it’s like nothing’s really changed at all.
lines.zh: : 对有些人来说，那感觉就像整个世界都崩塌了。可对另一些人来说，又好像什么都没变过。

lines.en: : What...is it like for you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那对您来说……是什么样的呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : If that’s...something you’re okay with me asking.
lines.zh: : 如果……我问这个您不介意的话。

lines.en: : I’m more interested in hearing what it’s like for you, if you’re okay with {i}me{/i} asking.
lines.zh: : 我倒是更想听听对你来说是什么样的，如果你不介意{i}我{/i}问的话。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip16
: Unfortunately...that’s not really an easy question for me {i}to{/i} answer.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是……这对我来说真不是个容易{i}回答{/i}的问题。

lines.en: : I’m kind of...terrified of it, really.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点……很怕它。

lines.en: : I don’t have any...{i}experience{/i} with death yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没有任何……关于死亡的{i}体验{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, other than my goldfish Benjamin who died when I was six years old. But I haven’t really thought about him again until right now and oh my God I am suddenly sad.
lines.zh: : 嗯，除了我六岁那年死掉的金鱼 Benjamin。不过在那之后我就再没想起过他，直到现在这一刻，天哪，我突然好难过。

lines.en: : Yeah. I think that’s kind of just...how it’s supposed to work after a while.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得过一段时间之后……本来就该是这个样子的。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, it’s not...
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，并不是……

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip17
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, it’s not like that for everyone. And we all have our own ways of facing it.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，并不是每个人都能那样。而且我们每个人都有一套自己面对它的方式。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll come to experience it someday. And I’m sure that, when you do, you’ll learn things about yourself that you’ve always feared learning.
lines.zh: : 我确定总有一天你会经历到。我也确定，等那一天到来时，你会认识到一些你一直害怕去认识的、关于你自己的事。

lines.en: : But I don’t think it’s something you should let suppress you. If you live in fear, you’ll miss out on a lot of the better parts of life.
lines.zh: : 但我不觉得你应该被它压垮。如果你活在恐惧里，就会错过生命中很多美好的部分。

lines.en: : And while there aren’t many of those when you’re as jaded and cynical as I am, they still exist.
lines.zh: : 虽说像我这样疲惫又愤世嫉俗的人，那样的美好已经不多了，但它们依然存在。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip18
: Yeah...you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……您大概是对的。

lines.en: : It just feels horrible not understanding what other people are going through because it’s like I can’t...help them as much as they need me to.
lines.zh: : 只是不懂别人正在经历什么，这种感觉太难受了，因为那就好像我没办法……按他们需要的那样去帮他们。

lines.en: : So sometimes I wish I {i}did{/i} understand. But I know that wishing that means something horrible would have to happen to me and...
lines.zh: : 所以有时候我真希望自己{i}能{/i}懂。可我也知道，要是许下这种愿望，就意味着我身上必须发生什么可怕的事，然后……

lines.en: : I guess I’m a little selfish in that sort of way.
lines.zh: : 我想，我在这方面大概是有点自私吧。

lines.en: : If your idea of selfishness is not wanting someone you love to die, I think you’re a lot more selfless than you believe.
lines.zh: : 如果你所谓的自私就是不想让自己爱的人死去，那我觉得你比你以为的要无私得多。

lines.en: : Umm...
: There are...other ways I’m selfish, you know...
lines.zh: : 我……还有别的方面也很自私的，你知道吗……

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip19
: Ways that are a lot less depressing and-
lines.zh: : 一些没这么让人沮丧的方面，而且——

lines.en: : Uhh...what the actual fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: : 呃……现在这他妈的到底是什么情况？

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip20
: K...Kirin?
lines.zh: : K……Kirin？

lines.en: : And Noriko! I am also here. Hi, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 还有 Noriko！我也在哦。你好呀，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hey. What are you two up to?
lines.zh: : 嗨。你们俩在忙什么？

lines.en: : Isn’t that what we should be asking you?
lines.zh: : 这句话不该是我们问你的吗？

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip21
Karin gets off of the bench and marches over to Kirin with a look of determination I seldom see from her in situations like these.
lines.zh: Karin 从长椅上站起来，大步走向 Kirin，脸上带着一种我在这种场合很少在她身上见到的坚定。

lines.en: It’s no joke to say she normally takes the backseat when dealing with her sister, but it seems that something about today’s {i}circumstances{/i} have made that very much not the case.
lines.zh: 说她在面对妹妹时通常会退让，这话一点都不夸张，但今天的{i}情况{/i}似乎让这一点彻底不成立。

lines.en: : Is there a problem, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗，Kirin？

lines.en: : Problem? No. I’m just surprised to see a prude like you out and about with an older man.
lines.zh: : 问题？没有。我只是挺惊讶，像你这么古板的家伙居然会跟一个老男人一起出门。

lines.en: : You know that a girl and a b...{i}boy{/i} can go out in public without being like that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道一个女生和一个男……{i}男生{/i}可以只是正常地一起出门，而不必是那种关系吧？

lines.en: : I prefer “man,” but please, proceed.
lines.zh: : 我更希望你说「男人」，不过请继续。

lines.en: : Of course {i}I{/i} know that. But does Sensei know that?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}当然知道。可 Sensei 知道吗？

lines.en: : Do you think we’re on a date or something? Is that why you’re so jealous right now?
lines.zh: : 你该不会以为我们在约会什么的吧？你现在这么嫉妒，就是因为这？

lines.en: : I mean...Imani {i}did{/i} say that-
lines.zh: : 我是说……Imani {i}确实{/i}说过——

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip22
: Jealous? You think I’m {i}jealous?{/i} Of what?
lines.zh: : 嫉妒？你觉得我在{i}嫉妒{/i}？嫉妒什么？

lines.en: : Just because there’s {i}one{/i} guy in your life that you can talk to without pissing yourself now doesn’t mean I’m suddenly going to be {i}jealous.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就因为你生命里终于出现了{i}一个{/i}能让你不吓得尿裤子的男人，可不代表我就会突然开始{i}嫉妒{/i}。

lines.en: : But hey, if you want to keep enjoying your {i}date,{/i} go ahead. Noriko and I are going to go buy new underwear.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，你要是想继续享受你的{i}约会，{/i}尽管继续。我和 Noriko 要去买新内衣了。

lines.en: : We are? I thought we were going to the mov-
lines.zh: : 我们要去吗？我还以为我们要去看电——

lines.en: : Shut up, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Noriko。

lines.en: : You want to know why we’re really here, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你想知道我们到底为什么来这儿吗，Kirin？

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. I’d {i}love{/i} to hear what sort of thing could get my sister out of the house and into the company of some fucking dinosaur.
lines.zh: : 行啊，当然。我倒{i}很想{/i}听听，到底是什么事能让我姐姐走出家门，去陪一只他妈的老恐龙。

lines.en: : That was unnecessary.
lines.zh: : 这话没必要说吧。

lines.en: : I agree. That was unnecessary. Sensei is in the prime of his life and you of all people should-
lines.zh: : 我同意。确实没必要。Sensei 正值壮年，而在场的人里最不该这么说的就是——

lines.en: : Shut the {i}fuck{/i} up, Noriko.
lines.zh: : {i}给我{/i}闭嘴，Noriko。

lines.en: : Fine. Since you want to know, I’ll tell you.
lines.zh: : 好。既然你想知道，我就告诉你。

lines.en: : Sensei and I are here to buy presents for Makoto. Who, in case you happened to forget, just lost her dad.
lines.zh: : 我和 Sensei 来这里是给 Makoto 买礼物的。她刚刚失去了父亲，你该不会忘了吧。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip23
: Hah...
: Yeah. Bet you feel like a jerk now, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你现在觉得自己是个混蛋了吧？

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene karinmalltrip24
: Well, how was I supposed to know that?! There’s no way anyone would guess that on the first try!
lines.zh: : 可我哪知道啊？！这种事谁也不可能一猜就中吧！

lines.en: : Can we go to the movies now? I don’t like it when I have to skip the previews and you’re always making us show up late.
lines.zh: : 我们现在能去看电影了吗？我不喜欢错过预告片，而且你老是害我们迟到。

lines.en: : Apologize.
lines.zh: : 道歉。

lines.en: : For what?! Assuming you two were {i}together?!{/i} Why are you even offended by that?!
lines.zh: : 道什么歉？！就因为我以为你俩{i}在一起{/i}？！这有什么好生气的？！

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to apologize to me. I’m asking you to apologize to Sensei for assuming he’d ever look at me that way.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你跟我道歉。我是要你跟 Sensei 道歉，因为你居然以为他会那样看我。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip25
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……

lines.en: : Don’t fucking hit on my sister, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 别他妈的勾搭我姐姐，Noriko。

lines.en: : I’m not saying I {i}wouldn’t...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我又没说我{i}不愿意{/i}……

lines.en: : Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip26
: You say weird stuff about my sister like fifteen times a day! How is this fair?!
lines.zh: : 你一天到晚说我姐姐的怪话要说上十五次！这公平吗？！

lines.en: : Shut up! We’re leaving!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我们走了！

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip27
: Fine. Let me just tell Sensei I love him a few thousand times first. I love you. I love you. I-
lines.zh: : 好吧。让我先跟 Sensei 说上几千遍我爱他。我爱你。我爱你。我——

lines.en: : Now’s probably not the best time, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 现在大概不是时候，Noriko。

lines.en: scene karinmalltrip28
: Just thought I’d remind you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想提醒你一下。就这样。

lines.en: : Is there anything you still need for Makoto? Kirin and I can pick something up after the movie.
lines.zh: : 给 Makoto 的东西还有什么缺的吗？看完电影我和 Kirin 可以顺便帮忙买。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because the only things left are a little on the pricey side and-
lines.zh: : 真的可以吗？因为剩下的东西都有点贵，而且——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t even worry about it. Just tell us what to get and we’ll help out in any way we can.
lines.zh: : 没关系。别在意这个。告诉我们该买什么就行，我们会尽力帮忙。

lines.en: scene black
Karin returns to the bench to grab her list out of her bag and rattles off the names of different items in her Makoto Miyamura condolence care package.
lines.zh: Karin 回到长椅边，从包里掏出清单，噼里啪啦地报出她给 Makoto Miyamura 的慰问包裹里要放的各种东西。

lines.en: Among them are a series of books that Miku and Maki compiled into a list, several packages of assorted fancy fruits, skin care products, and other things of that nature.
lines.zh: 其中有 Miku 和 Maki 列成书单的一系列书、几盒高级什锦水果、护肤品，以及其他类似的东西。

lines.en: Kirin and Noriko note everything down in their phones before leaving the two of us alone and, knowing that they’ll be getting at least the skin care stuff, our trip is significantly shortened.
lines.zh: Kirin 和 Noriko 把这些一一记进手机，然后留下我们两个人；既然护肤品至少有她们负责，我们这趟行程就大大缩短了。

lines.en: We leave the mall to meet back up with Imani and the others and, within the hour, I am removed from the group.
lines.zh: 我们离开商场去和 Imani 她们汇合，不到一个小时，我就被从这群人里剔了出去。

lines.en: This time, however, I’m not paired with an attractive girl to spend the rest of the day with and am forced to go home alone to drown in my thoughts.
lines.zh: 不过这一次，我没有被分配到一个漂亮的女孩陪我度过余下的一天，只能独自回家，淹没在自己的思绪里。

lines.en: Among those thoughts are several visions of emerald eyes.
lines.zh: 那些思绪里，反复浮现出一双双翡翠般的眼眸。

lines.en: And how my desire to pluck them becomes greater each time they appear.
lines.zh: 以及每当它们出现时，我想要把它们挖出来的欲望就变得更强烈。

$ karin_love += 1
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]！{/i}
